recipes.name: STOCK & CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients: 1 leek (or a Spanish/white onion), roughly chopped
1 head garlic, halved horizontally (no need to peel)
2 1/2 chicken spines, carcasses, or 1 lb chicken wings
2 tbsp olive oil or other flavorful oil
2 cups egg noodles or pasta of choice
instructions: Roughly chop and peel your aromatics like celery, carrots, leek, parsnip, onions, turnip, and garlic. - 3 celery stalks roughly chopped - 3 carrots peeled and roughly chopped - 1 leek (or a Spanish/white onion) roughly chopped - 1 parsnip peeled and rougly chopped - 1 large Spanish onion quartered - 1 turnip peeled and roughly chopped (optional) - 1 head garlic halved horizontally (no need to peel)
Chop leftover chicken spine or neck. If not available, chicken wings work. - 2 ½ chicken spines carcasses, or 1 lb chicken wings
In a large pot, add oil and bring to a shimmer then add in the chicken bones/wings and brown. - 1 ½ tbsp vegetable or canola oil - 2 ½ chicken spines carcasses, or 1 lb chicken wings

Once the chicken begins to brown, add in the vegetables, fresh herbs, and peppercorns. Add water to cover. - 3 carrots peeled and roughly chopped - 3 celery stalks roughly chopped - 1 leek (or a Spanish/white onion) roughly chopped - 1 parsnip peeled and rougly chopped - 1 turnip peeled and roughly chopped (optional) - 1 head garlic halved horizontally (no need to peel) - 1 large Spanish onion quartered - 3 a few sprigs fresh thyme - 3 a few sprigs fresh parsley - 1 tsp whole peppercorns - water to cover
Bring stock to a bare simmer skimming any scum off the top. Simmer for 4-12 hours.
Drain the solids out of the stock and set stock aside but keep warm or chilled until ready to use.
Begin by roughly chopping celery, carrots, a finely chopped parsnip and turnip and place into a bowl. - 2 carrots peeled and chopped - 1 parsnip finely chopped - ½ turnip chopped (optional)
Separately chop an onion and set to the side. - 1 onion chopped
In a large pot, heat some oil over medium-high heat until shimmering then add the onions. Saute until softened. - 2 tbsp olive oil or other flavorful oil - 1 onion chopped
Add the rest of the vegetables and warm through before adding stock. - 2 carrots peeled and chopped - 1 parsnip finely chopped - ½ turnip chopped (optional) - 6 to 8 cups Chicken Stock (see above)
Over high heat bring to a simmer.
While coming up to a simmer, add in chopped parsley, grated ginger and lemongrass. - fresh parsley chopped (optional) - 1 tbsp grated ginger - 1 stalk lemongrass finely chopped (optional)
Once boiling, add in the chicken thighs and skim off any fat that rises to the surface as it cooks. - 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
After 15-20 minutes, remove the chicken and shred using a pair of forks before adding back to the pot. - 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
Right at the end add fresh chopped dill along with minced scallions. Cook for no more than 1 minute. Season with salt - fresh dill chopped - 2 ½ scallions minced - salt and pepper to taste

In a medium pot, add a few ladles full of the soup along with some noodles and boil until noodles are cooked. Season with salt as necessary. - 2 cups egg noodles or pasta of choice - salt and pepper to taste
